profile.headline: Software Engineer at The Florida Senate
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with a background in full-stack development for enterprise-level projects. Throughout my career, I have contributed to modernizing and maintaining complex systems, delivering solutions that address critical business needs. My experience spans the full development lifecycle, from planning and design to deployment and support, ensuring reliable and scalable outcomes. With a strong eye for detail and a passion for innovation, I thrive in dynamic, collaborative environments, consistently driving projects to success through problem-solving, adaptability, and effective teamwork.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Modernizing the Florida Senate's desktop and web applications by migrating to an updated platform with improved architecture, streamlined deployment processes, and greater scalability and maintainability.

• Developing frontend features using Angular 2+, HTML, CSS, Angular CDK, NgRx, and RxJS to create responsive, maintainable, and user-friendly interfaces.

• Implementing real time updates and notifications using SignalR for seamless backend-to-frontend communication.

• Leveraging SharePoint CSOM to access and launch documents from the on-premises environment.

• Providing support for legacy applications during active legislative sessions to ensure stability.

• Developing Azure DevOps pipelines with YAML, reusable task groups, and automated MSIX packaging and DigiCert signing.

• Utilizing MySQL and Entity Framework for efficient data access and database interactions.

• Collaborating in an Agile framework with QA testers, participating in sprints, issue resolution, feature implementation, and conducting demos to stakeholders and end users.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a 12-member team developing and maintaining the Baralogix® web application for optimizing drilling operations across onshore and offshore rigs.

• Built client-side features using Angular 2+, TypeScript, HTML/CSS, Bootstrap, and Angular’s core tools (forms, routing, services, dependency injection, guards, lifecycle hooks, and async functions).

• Developed server-side functionality with ASP.NET Core, integrating SignalR for real-time communication and connecting the application with Azure cloud services.

• Set up and managed SignalR hub connections for WebSocket communication and integrated multiple Azure services into the platform.

• Used VS Code for front-end work and Visual Studio 2019 for back-end development.

• Utilized Swagger and Postman for API testing, and worked with MongoDB for data querying and manipulation.

• Performed code reviews and managed features, bugs, and pull requests within Azure DevOps.

• Deployed updates to production after successful UAT/field testing, ensuring smooth releases with minimal downtime.

• Followed Agile practices to support bug fixing, testing, code reviews, and implementation of client-requested changes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built backend services using ASP.NET Core, integrating SignalR for real-time communication, Azure services, and Entity Framework as the ORM.

• Created C# controllers and endpoints with token-based authorization, implemented SignalR hub connections, and added strong backend validation for data integrity.

• Used Visual Studio 2019 for server-side development and VS Code for Angular 2+ and TypeScript frontend components, following a modular, component-based architecture.

• Performed BDD testing with Cucumber, end-to-end testing with Protractor, and API testing with Swagger.

• Worked with SQL Server Management Studio to query, update, and manage data using T-SQL.

• Conducted thorough code reviews in Azure DevOps and supported the deployment process after UAT and code freeze.

• Participated in Agile sprints with daily standups to address bugs, testing, reviews, and client feature requests.

• Presented the project at UiPath Forward III 2019 in Las Vegas.
